name: coinflip
description: Create a simple web application that uses the fs and http modules. Use http to create the server and fs to read your html file. Include vanilla ES6 js in a script tag at the bottom of your html file. Try creating a coin flip guessing game ### Tech Stack: ### HTML  For the structure. ### CSS  For styling. ### JavaScript  ### node server ### How to View: Download or clone this repo. Open index.html in your browser. Click the link on the right under About to see the live demo.
